episodes.instruction: Grab the dark mug with a curved handle, turn it, set it on the table, then hang it on the dark gray rack with flat back.
Lift the cylindrical mug with handle from the table, spin it, set it down, and hang it on the rack with straight and slanted rods.
Pick the cylindrical mug with the left arm, rotate, place it, then hang it on the rack with straight and slanted rods.
